caveats: SIMATIC SD is a per-version dialect: the .s7dcl header must match the target portal (V20 uses S7_Language; V21 uses S7_PreferredLanguage+S7_Version). A dialect mismatch fails import with Siemens' MISLEADING 'Block Language is not defined | .s7res has no en-US entries' — the real cause is the dialect, NOT the .s7res (real-machine confirmed: a V20 block with an empty .s7res imports fine on V20). Regenerate with schema_version matching the portal version.
